item.title: [LU-20525] Lustre utilities interactive mode defects
item.description:
When lnetctl , lctl or lfs utilities are invoked in interactive mode, the first compound command works correctly however the subsequent commands fail():

[root@rocky96 wc-master]# ./lnet/utils/lnetctl 
> net show
net:
-     net type: lo
      local NI(s):
      -     nid: 0@lo
            status: up
-     net type: tcp
      local NI(s):
      -     nid: 192.168.50.90@tcp
            status: up
            interfaces:
                  0: eth1
> net show
usage: lt-lnetctl [COMMAND] [OPTIONS]... [ARGS]
Without any parameters, interactive mode is invoked
Try 'lt-lnetctl help <COMMAND>', or 'lt-lnetctl --list-commands' for a list of commands.
> net show --verbose
usage: lt-lnetctl [COMMAND] [OPTIONS]... [ARGS]
Without any parameters, interactive mode is invoked
Try 'lt-lnetctl help <COMMAND>', or 'lt-lnetctl --list-commands' for a list of commands.
> add
missing mandatory parameters in NI config: 'network'
>

the happens with lctl command, for example, nodemap info:

[root@rocky96 wc-master]# ./lustre/utils/lctl
> nodemap info
nodemap.active=0
nodemap.default.admin_nodemap=0
nodemap.default.audit_mode=1
nodemap.default.banlist=[]
nodemap.default.child_raise_privileges=none
nodemap.default.deny_mount=0
nodemap.default.deny_unknown=0
nodemap.default.dt_stats=
...
nodemap.default.rbac=file_perms,dne_ops,quota_ops,byfid_ops,chlg_ops,fscrypt_admin,server_upcall,ignore_root_prjquota,hsm_ops,pool_quota_ops,lqa_quota_ops,projid_set,foreign_ops
nodemap.default.readonly_mount=0
nodemap.default.squash_gid=65534
nodemap.default.squash_projid=65534
nodemap.default.squash_uid=65534
nodemap.default.trusted_nodemap=0
> nodemap info
usage: lt-lctl nodemap [COMMAND] [OPTIONS]... [ARGS]
Without any parameters, interactive mode is invoked
Try 'lt-lctl nodemap help <COMMAND>', or 'lt-lctl nodemap --list-commands' for a list of commands.
>

i.e. it is a common problem for the lustre interactive utilities.

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.
